regulation_scope: Reg M-A and Reg M-B Showdown battle logs from downloaded HTML replays
policy: These rows may harden replay parsing, battle-flow QA, coaching calibration, and Showdown parity. They must not promote official Pokemon Champions legality or Team Lab official rankings.

rules: Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon
Item Clause: Limit 1 of each item
rows.notes: Pokemon Showdown replay HTML. Useful reference gameplay evidence, not official Pokemon Champions in-game legality proof.
